environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; storytelling focus; emphasis on speed and agility; clean quadrant borders; expressive 'character-driven' movements.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A tiny, vivid lizard head poking out of a small, parchment-like white egg tucked into a rock crack; Top-Right (Dining): The lizard mid-leap, capturing a dragonfly-like insect in mid-air with its tongue; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): The lizard flattened against a warm, flat stone, eyes closed in total relaxation, soaking up the heat; Bottom-Right (Playing/Social): Two lizards performing a 'push-up' display to one another on a log, a common social behavior, with their colorful throat fans (dewlaps) extended.
visual_logic.ground: A mix of smooth river stones, purple mudstone, and small patches of green moss.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even daylight to emphasize the tiny details of the scales and the fast-paced action in the 'Dining' and 'Playing' scenes.
